astrometric_debiasing.inner_triple_calibration: Strictly inner [500, 2000] AU super-Keplerian tail (> sqrt(2 + (2.5*sigma)^2)) forward Opik+Rayleigh propagation
astrometric_debiasing.perspective_pm: Exact 3D ICRS tangent-triad rotation at common pair distance d_kpc
astrometric_debiasing.ricean_pm_noise: Wardle-Kronberg 4th-order perpendicular variance subtraction sqrt(max(dv^2 - sigma_v_perp^2, (0.10*sigma_v_perp)^2))

photometric_mass_solver.giant_gate_rule: M_G < 3.5 and bp_rp > 0.92 -> flagged GIANT (excluded in v2)
photometric_mass_solver.method: Pecaut-Mamajek monotonic PCHIP M_G spline + Gentile Fusillo WD locus + RGB giant gate
